passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
passive.text: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

spells.name: Flair
spells.text: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

spells.name: Blade Whirl
spells.text: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

spells.name: Wild Rush
spells.text: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.

spells.name: Inferno Trigger
spells.text: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

damage.value: Samira deals sustained damage with repeated attacks and abilities, including additional magic damage from melee-range attacks.

archetype.value: Samira is a mobile damage dealer who dashes through enemies and attacks at close range.

axis.value: Samira looks for crowd-control setups to go all-in.

spikes.at: Samira's rank-five Flair has a 2-second cooldown
spikes.why: Samira can use Flair more frequently to deal damage.

bait.why: Samira cannot dash with Wild Rush while it is on cooldown unless she kills an enemy champion to refresh it.

mistakes.value: Samira loses combo progress by repeating the same type of hit instead of alternating attacks and abilities.
